title: A posteriori error analysis for the Navier-Stokes equations with non-smooth data
summary: We study the stationary Navier-Stokes equations with Dirichlet boundary data in L2, a setting in which the limited regularity of the solution prevents the direct application of standard a posteriori error estimation techniques. To address this issue, we introduce a regularized formulation that yields a well-posed approximation of the original problem and admits a conforming finite element discretization.
